title: Life Plan Benefits Bulletin: Care Cover on Re-Leveled Respite Nights
content:
Households holding a Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement carry their plan's care fee discount into the care increase on a level-change segment of an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

**Benefit.** The Life Plan care cover on the re-leveled nights is the care fee discount of the guest's plan, taken as a percentage of the care increase, for a guest who holds an occupied Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement on a lifecare plan or on a fee-for-service plan, and nothing for any other guest. The care increase billed per re-leveled night is reduced by the cover: it is multiplied by the part of it the cover leaves.

The records read are the guest's Entrance Fee Agreement, whether it is in occupied status, the contract type of its plan and the plan's care fee discount.

## Cover by holding

| Guest's Entrance Fee Agreement | Contract type | Care fee discount of the plan | Part of the care increase still billed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Occupied, on a LifeCare plan (LifeCare Declining Balance Plan, LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan) | Lifecare | 100 percent | None of it |
| Occupied, on a LifeChoice plan (LifeChoice Declining Balance, 50%, 75% or 90% Refundable Plan) | Fee-for-service | 10 percent | 90 percent of it |
| None occupied | — | — | No cover; 0 percent |

## Hypothetical illustrations (care increase 45.00 per re-leveled night)

- Occupied LifeChoice agreement: 45.00 reduced by 10 percent, that is 40.50 per re-leveled night.
- Occupied LifeCare agreement: 45.00 reduced by 100 percent, that is nothing per re-leveled night; the re-leveled nights carry the locked nightly rate alone.
- Agreement in reserved or terminated status, or none at all: no cover, 45.00 per re-leveled night.
